intended_use: Premium launch hero image for a vertical social feed and landing-page crop.

prompt.scene: A warm-white minimal studio with no visible horizon line. A restrained ribbon of air is implied by a few fine, translucent strands curving upward behind the product.
prompt.subject: The fictional Northstar AirLift shampoo bottle from @product-pack-001 stands upright in the lower center. Beside it, the back and side profile of an adult model's naturally lifted hair enters from the upper right; the face is outside frame.
prompt.action: The hair is caught at the apex of one fluid turn, forming a soft open arc without rigid spray-set strands.
prompt.composition: Vertical 2:3 composition. Bottle occupies about 42% of image height and remains the sharp focal anchor. Hair creates a diagonal motion path from upper right toward the bottle. Preserve 18% clean negative space above and 12% on the left for copy.
prompt.lighting: Soft warm directional light from upper left, controlled silver highlights on the cap, translucent glow through the liquid, realistic contact shadow, restrained contrast.
prompt.materials_style: Photorealistic premium beauty still life with real-camera texture, natural hair detail, transparent plastic and liquid fidelity, subtle fine grain, contemporary editorial restraint rather than glossy CGI perfection.

exact_text.placement: upper left inside the reserved negative space, two lines
exact_text.typography: clean modern uppercase sans serif, restrained weight, generous tracking

references.role: Use only for exact bottle geometry, cap, label layout, wordmark, and liquid color.
Use only for warm directional light and shadow softness.

constraints: The product must look physically plausible and upright.
Hair must look touchable, mobile, and naturally lifted.
Use only the listed exact text.
Keep all subjects adult and non-identifiable.
exclude: no extra logos or packaging text

inspection: Verify exact bottle geometry, cap, label, wordmark, and liquid color against the source reference.
Verify the exact headline text and that no other text appears.
Verify hair anatomy, strand continuity, and believable motion.
Verify negative space survives both social and landing-page crops.
Verify no medical or hair-growth implication was introduced.

rights.notes: Fictional product and non-identifiable adult model.
